answer.short: Sixteen declared source classes are bound to named backends in routing_spec.json. Each class canary host-binds to its primary backend; both urllib and http.client probes go RED when every primary_backend is replaced by refute-nonexistent-backend. Admission is computed: a healthy fixture reaches ALLOW, while remaining=0, DOWN, and AUTH fixtures reach BLOCK. Live fan-out of 50 agents is BLOCK on this worker because unconfigured historical MCP routes, policy-blocked Tor, and/or measured quota/reachability reasons remain. Known-good IANA is UP and 127.0.0.1:1 is DOWN.
